recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up portrait of a man wearing a cowboy hat and denim, set against a textured blue backdrop. The composition features a high-contrast lighting scheme that emphasizes facial texture and eye color, with a distressed, custom-lettered logo positioned in the lower-left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The brim of the hat creates a diagonal frame across the top third of the image.
The subject's blue eyes echo the saturation of the background.
The white distressed typography contrasts sharply against the dark denim and blue background.
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up cropping that cuts off the top of the hat and one side of the face.
Denim texture visible in the clothing.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is off-center to the right, occupying roughly 70% of the frame in an extreme close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's right eye (viewer's left) serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down the bridge of the nose to the lips, then sweeps left to the typographic logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper left and lower left corners, providing a landing spot for text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and tan hat felt.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white text and dark background; high saturation in the blues against neutral skin tones.

letterConstructionRules: Thick, blocky strokes with sharp, triangular serifs.
Irregular, hand-cut edges to simulate woodblock printing.
Integrated swashes, specifically a long tail on the initial 'L' or 'D' equivalent.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The baseline is slightly arched or staggered.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family focus with varying scale and distress levels.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Western Slab Serif (e.g., Mesquite or Ironwood style)
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the country/western aesthetic and heavy weight.
Captures the eroded, tactile feel of the lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution, extreme close-up portrait of a man with blue eyes wearing a tan cowboy hat and a blue denim shirt. The lighting should be dramatic, highlighting skin texture. The background is a textured, dark blue studio wall. Crop the image so the hat brim cuts diagonally across the top and the face is off-center to the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a two-line stacked logo in the lower left corner using a heavy, distressed slab-serif font in white. The text should have a weathered, 'stamped' appearance with rough edges and internal grit.

verificationChecks: Is the text positioned over the denim shirt area?
Is the eye color a prominent blue matching the background?
Does the hat brim create a clear diagonal line?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and logo marks
Unique facial features of the specific individual
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hat brim does not cover the eyes.
Check that the white text is legible against the blue denim.
Verify the skin texture is realistic and not overly smoothed.
Confirm the background has a subtle vignette or texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme close-up portrait + diagonal hat brim + textured blue background + distressed slab-serif typography in lower-left.
